title: Horizontal bodies block hitscan bullets but only when in crit.
body:
## Description
Bodies that are horizontal while in crit will block bullets from passing over them. 

In a gun fight its very op to take cover behind a body on the floor since they will tank all the shots for you.

It also not very consistent that the same body will suddenly stop blocking bullets once it is dead.

**Reproduction**
1.  Place a dead body on the floor.
2. Try to shoot behind it.
3. Observe how the body will only block bullets while it is alive or in crit.

**Additional context**
On a side note, it is also impossible to shoot directly at a body once it is dead. The bullet will instead continue on its trajectory instead of impacting and stopping at the body.

Is this a limitation of how hitscan works currently?

Should bodies on the floor have to be clicked on for the bullet to hit them while alive or dead?

Applies to both laser and physical hitscan bullets.

On the portable, at first launch (config missing) if you press no to the prompt only the command window will display. About 20 seconds later the application loads -- locks the mouse but doesn't show the window until you Alt-tab.

```lua
    for _, dir in pairs(possible_locations) do
      if status then break end
      for _, folder in pairs(possible_folders) do
        local path = dir .. pathsep .. folder

        if lfs.attributes(path, "mode") == "directory" and self:isThemeHospitalPath(path) then

          self.config.theme_hospital_install = path
          status, _ = self.fs:setRoot(path)
          break
        end
      end
```

Looks like this directory entry (windows tries to connect to network locations with \\\\): ``dir     \\Documents``
i.e. this entry in ``possible_locations``: ``      user_dir and (user_dir .. pathsep ..  "Documents"):``

### Is there an existing issue for this?

### Contact Details

You can reply here or get my attention faster on twitter @zhu346p

### Version Info

Latest available release

### What operating system are you seeing the problem on?

macOS

### Bug Behavior

Tested on MacOS both 11.6 and 12.3 (other OS versions untested) with Apple Silicon M1 translated with rosetta2

If a pack contains video assets, scrolling through of them will cause a "Too many open files" prompt to come up and keep recurring. On version 0.71.1 you may crash to the crash handler but I have not gotten this on 0.71.2 yet.

For some reason crashing to the crash handler on MacOS didn't give me a crashlog text file. Despite this happening numerous times in the past few months testing it out my crash folder is empty.




### Expected Behavior

You should be able to scroll normally without encountering error popups, regardless of whether the pack contains videos or not.

### Reproduction Steps

1. Run the game
2. Select a pack that contains songs that have video assets
3. Scroll through the list of songs for about a minute
4. The errors will start popping up

[Refer to this video for the reproduction steps. ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1UcEvgdYMvI)

Both tests done with the same pack. 
Folder titled "Crash" has all the video assets like a normal download would.
Folder that is titled normally has all video assets (.mp4, .avi) removed and does not crash regardless of how long I scroll the list.
